scopecontent.p: Correspondence and subject files, 2006-2014, of Virginia Auditor of Public Accounts Walter Kucharski. These records are in electronic format and consist of the official correspondence of the Auditor with state agencies, localities, legislators, governor's office and constituents. The majority of this collection consists of correspondence, but also includes accounting spreadsheets, briefings, financial documentation, guidance, legislative review, memoranda, presentations, proposals, studies, reports and documentation on analysis, calculations, clarifications, and projections.

Topics include, but are not limited to: accounting guidance and clarification, appropriations, audits, budgeting, capital expenditures, debt service, fines and fees, funding, legislation, revenue analysis for state agencies, various state funds, higher education restructuring, and other related topics.
Collection consists of 1,180 files. File types include: doc, htm, msg, jpg, onepkg, pdf, ppt, txt and xls.
